daily.title: Trump told Xi helping Iran is unacceptable, US ambassador says
daily.summary: Amid the tea-drinking and pleasantries in Washington this week, Donald Trump said he did bring up the Iran war with Xi Jinping and China's support for Tehran.

daily.title: Bali Nine drug mule released from jail after being spared death row
daily.summary: Mary Jane Veloso was due to be executed in Indonesia in 2015 alongside Australians Andrew Chan and Myuran Sukumaran, but she was spared at the last minute.

daily.title: Man City guilty of breaching EPL financial rules, punishment still pending
daily.summary: Global football heavyweights Manchester City have been found guilty of 114 beaches of the English Premier League's financial regulations, after a years-long investigation.

daily.title: Pope Leo says UN risks becoming 'charade' as he sounds alarm over AI
daily.summary: During a visit to Paris, the pontiff warned of the dangers of "losing our humanity" to AI and that multi-lateral organisations may be in crisis.

daily.title: Trump accuser E Jean Carroll finally gets her damages
daily.summary: Lawyers have shut down Donald Trump's attempt to raise a court case to take back the money awarded to E Jean Carroll, the only person to successfully sue Mr Trump for sexual assault.

daily.title: Sydney man becomes first jailed under Nazi salute laws
daily.summary: Nathan Ballesty was arrested in December after the AFP launched an investigation into a post in which he called for Prime Minister Anthony Albanese to be kidnapped.

daily.title: At least eight killed as Russia and Ukraine trade strikes
daily.summary: At least eight people have been killed, including a 14-year-old boy, during drone attacks across Russia and Ukraine.

daily.title: 'Makeshift' treatment areas and long waits reported at major Adelaide hospital ED
daily.summary: Patients waited more than 13 hours to be treated at the biggest emergency department in Adelaide's northern suburbs, which has been operating at "crisis" levels for months, according to SA's doctors' union.

daily.title: Man dies after fall at Hanging Rock summit
daily.summary: The tourist spot will be closed over the long weekend following a deadly fall on Friday afternoon.

daily.title: Police lay 115 additional charges on Sydney alleged childcare abuser
daily.summary: Former Sydney childcare worker Hamish Tait is now 444 facing charges related to the alleged abuse of children over a 16-year period.

daily.title: Late Brazil goal denies Socceroos famous win after stunning Irankunda free kick
daily.summary: Brazil scored with the last touch of the game to deny the Socceroos a famous victory in Townsville, after a stunning free kick from Nestory Irankunda gave the Socceroos the lead.

daily.title: Red-hot Roosters roar into NRL grand final
daily.summary: The Roosters are the first team through to the NRL grand final after dismantling the Dolphins at Lang Park.

daily.title: Father rejects coroner's conclusion on newborn son's death
daily.summary: A Queensland father says he will seek to have the findings of an inquest into his five-day-old son's death set aside.

daily.title: 'Evil' Catholic priest who sexually abused girls in foster care jailed
daily.summary: Robert Hickman, now aged 81, had already served time in New South Wales for similar offences, with the court hearing that he first started abusing children in the late 1970s.

daily.title: 'He will be finished': Toplace lawyer's promise to fugitive developer
daily.summary: The former underling of disgraced developer Jean Nassif has denied in ICAC he was part of a campaign to smear the state's building commissioner.

daily.title: Eagles keep Dons winless, Dogs put Power on the brink
daily.summary: Essendon slumps to a 0–7 record after a final-quarter fightback against West Coast fell short, while the Bulldogs beat Port to move to 5–2.

daily.title: Officer cleared of DV charges but 'not a finding complainant has lied'
daily.summary: A police security officer is acquitted of domestic violence charges, but an Adelaide judge has said that does not mean the "complainant has lied in her evidence".

daily.title: Former foster carers heartbroken after death of baby girl in Ballarat
daily.summary: The former foster carers of an eight-month-old baby girl who died days after being returned to her biological parents say the entire child protection system needs to be demolished and rebuilt from the ground up.

daily.title: Company pleads guilty over mechanic's death in 2023
daily.summary: A mining maintenance company in Western Australia's Goldfields has pleaded guilty over the death of a worker nearly three years ago.

daily.title: Albury childcare centre shut down as safety probe launched
daily.summary: The NSW independent regulator in early education and child care has shut down an Albury childcare service for six months while it investigates alleged child safety risks.

daily.title: Fishtailing caravan captured on truckie dash cam prompts holiday warning
daily.summary: Dash-cam footage captures the frightening moment a caravan begins fishtailing while overtaking a truck driver in Western Australia's Great Southern region.

daily.title: Kangaroo skin sculpture honouring 'every survival story' wins Defence art prize
daily.summary: The Australian War Memorial is displaying highly commended pieces while people can vote online for a people's choice winner.

daily.title: CCTV shows Beau Lamarre-Condon outside home on day of double killing
daily.summary: Georgia Cook, a friend of former police officer Beau Lamarre-Condon, gave evidence at his murder trial on Friday and said she had met the defendant at a boat party in 2021.

daily.title: Bungled Sydney Water payroll rollout leaves workers underpaid
daily.summary: Three unions have voted for work stoppages and work bans after a new payroll system has been routinely paying employees incorrectly or late since July.

daily.title: Dockers fans to marry outside MCG during AFL grand final
daily.summary: Fremantle fans Danni Bloomfield and Matt Abbott have flown to Melbourne from Karratha to get married outside the MCG before watching their beloved Dockers contest the premiership.

developing.title: Live: ASX recovers from three-month low, surging oil prices drag Wall Street lower
developing.summary: The Australian share market has risen slightly, though is still trading near its lowest level since mid-June. Wall Street extended its sell-off as oil prices spiked on further signs of disruption in Saudi Arabian crude supplies. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Burke to unveil Labor's revamped migration policy tomorrow after delay
developing.summary: Tony Burke will announce Labor's highly anticipated migration overhaul tomorrow, a month after he was forced to postpone a planned address. Follow live.

developing.title: Breaking: Emergency warning for fire at Blackmore, west of Berry Springs
developing.summary: Bushfires Northern Territory have issued an emergency warning for a fire at Stockwell Road in Blackmore, west of Berry Springs.

developing.title: Breaking: Olympic authorities sign off on controversial rowing and canoeing venue
developing.summary: The Fitzroy River in Rockhampton will host the events despite concerns over its current, length and crocodile inhabitants.

developing.title: Live: RBA more likely to raise rates as US Federal Reserve lifts to 4pc
developing.summary: Markets are pricing in a nearly 90 per cent chance of Australia's reserve bank lifting interest rates in September following the US Federal Reserve's decision to hike rates.

developing.title: Live: Labor folds to pressure, scraps $5,000 veterans allied health cap
developing.summary: The federal government has bowed to pressure and scrapped its proposed $5,000 veteran allied health cap announced in this year's federal budget. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Qantas seeks to avert freight ground crew strikes
developing.summary: Qantas is heading to the Fair Work Commission as hundreds of ground workers plan strikes next week. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

developing.title: Live: Minister won't say if migration shake-up has undergone economic modelling
developing.summary: Amanda Rishworth has sidestepped questions about whether the government has undertaken economic modelling of its migration changes. Follow live.
